name: Athiye Jawad
description: Athiye Jawad is an aerospace engineer, space-industry leader and independent strategy consultant specialising in satellite technologies, Earth observation and emerging technologies. She most recently served as Head of Business for MENA and Senior Director of Business Development for EMEA at Planet Labs, advancing the use of satellite intelligence to address global challenges. Her career spans leading global organisations including Airbus, Rolls-Royce and Corning. A graduate of ISAE-SUPAERO, France, Athiye works at the intersection of aerospace, satellite connectivity, climate and innovation, championing the power of space technologies to connect people, bridge digital divides and transform how we understand and shape our future on Earth and beyond.
